objective: Implement one synthetic-only frozen Apple baseline execution plane with a server-issued immutable cutoff, exact Mail/Calendar/Contacts windows, bounded paging, durable resume, admission-before-checkpoint ordering, and append-only start-date changes.
out_of_scope: Slice F watchers, reconciliation lifecycle, rolling horizon and permission recovery
Slice G frontend and any WP-10 or WP-11 behavior
Slice H live gates, live Apple data, TCC, credentials, signing, notarization or activation
external-model disclosure, deployment, source mutation, destructive purge or risk acceptance
failed_attempts: The first migration used the central metadata constraint name instead of the frozen prior-revision PostgreSQL name; corrected and rerun.
The first applied-head parity check exposed ALTER-appended column order differing from central metadata; declarations were reordered and parity passed.

The first populated-prior-head upgrade correctly hit the append-only run trigger while backfilling new frozen columns; the migration now transactionally disables only that trigger for the bounded backfill and immediately re-enables it, and roundtrip passes.
The first E unit run had an undersized deterministic clock and one incorrect expected post-terminal read count; both tests were corrected to the actual executor lifecycle and rerun clean.

Final self-review found that nullable migration columns preserved legacy rows but also permitted new unbound job and checkpoint inserts; INSERT triggers now reject both bypasses, with direct SQL negative plants.

The first corrected combined database rerun had one historical-revision test call a current-head RETURNING shape; the historical constraint test now uses its own revision's SQL and all 28 combined tests pass.

The first full database tier found 25 cleanup setup errors from the new checkpoint foreign key and one stale trigger inventory; exact disposable-fixture dependency lists and the trigger expectation were updated, and the complete 26-test failed set passes.
limitations: This slice is synthetic-only and establishes no live Apple feasibility or activation evidence.
A crash after durable admission but before checkpoint intentionally replays that page; Slice C idempotency prevents duplicate immutable versions.
Exact-head independent review and green PR CI are required before criteria are discharged.
